C_P: Molar heat capacity at constant pressure
C_V: Molar heat capacity at constant volume
Q_c: Heat a refrigerator takes from the cold side
Q_in: Heat taken in from the hot side
Q_out: Heat given out to the cold side
V_1: Volume at the start of a leg
V_2: Volume at the end of a leg
W_net: Net work done in one cycle
